name: 吳李洋
objective:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

name: 吳南葳
objective:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■ 第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■ 第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■ 第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
This four-year course is taught over eight semesters and aims to develop the following core professional competencies:
■ First Year: Foundations of Architectural Design
The first year focuses on the fundamentals of architectural design and form-making. Students develop basic design skills through the study of scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space.
■ Second Year: People and Space, and the Internal Components of Architecture
Building upon fundamental design skills, the second year introduces the basic dimensions and principles of architectural design. Topics include the relationship between the human body and space, patterns of human behavior and use, the physical environment of buildings, construction and structural systems, systems of architectural composition, and architectural types and forms.
■ Third Year: Urban Architecture
The third year focuses on urban architecture, emphasizing the relationship between architecture and its surrounding environmental systems and urban fabric. Students learn to incorporate an understanding of the external environment and urban theories into architectural planning and design.
■ Fourth Year: Graduation Design Project
The fourth year is dedicated to the thesis design project. Students develop the ability to investigate specific architectural issues and are encouraged to explore social, cultural, and natural concerns through architectural thinking. They are expected to respond to these issues through a comprehensive architectural design proposal.

本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

name: 黃光廷
objective:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■ 第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■ 第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■ 第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
This four-year course is taught over eight semesters and aims to develop the following core professional competencies:
■ First Year: Foundations of Architectural Design
The first year focuses on the fundamentals of architectural design and form-making. Students develop basic design skills through the study of scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space.
■ Second Year: People and Space, and the Internal Components of Architecture
Building upon fundamental design skills, the second year introduces the basic dimensions and principles of architectural design. Topics include the relationship between the human body and space, patterns of human behavior and use, the physical environment of buildings, construction and structural systems, systems of architectural composition, and architectural types and forms.
■ Third Year: Urban Architecture
The third year focuses on urban architecture, emphasizing the relationship between architecture and its surrounding environmental systems and urban fabric. Students learn to incorporate an understanding of the external environment and urban theories into architectural planning and design.
■ Fourth Year: Graduation Design Project
The fourth year is dedicated to the thesis design project. Students develop the ability to investigate specific architectural issues and are encouraged to explore social, cultural, and natural concerns through architectural thinking. They are expected to respond to these issues through a comprehensive architectural design proposal.
